stories.title: The Missing Moon Lantern
stories.logline: The village's Moon Lantern vanished the night before the festival. Find out who took it, and why.

stories.title: Lantern Tide
stories.logline: In a village of drifting lighthouses, an apprentice keeper with a lost year follows the missing oil to a thirteenth light that nobody remembers.

stories.title: The Ashen Envelope
stories.logline: A riverside clerk is found dead beside a blackened envelope; help Holmes learn where he died, who silenced him, and what the missing relief money concealed.

stories.title: Paddington and the Missing Hat
stories.logline: Paddington's hat is gone. The marmalade is gone too. And everyone is acting strange! Help Paddington find out why.
